purpose: Form RSC-1 is used to apply to the Tribunal to confirm a reduction of share capital of a company.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the application in Form No. RSC-1.
Pay the prescribed fee as per the Schedule of fee.
Attach the required certified list of creditors and certificates.
File the application with the Tribunal.
Keep copies of the list of creditors at the registered office for inspection.
checklist: List of creditors certified as true and correct by the Managing Director or two directors.
List of creditors made as on a date not earlier than fifteen days prior to the date of filing.
Certificate from the company auditor that the list of creditors is correct.
Certificate by the auditor and declaration by a director that deposits and interest are not in arrears.
Certificate by the auditor that the proposed accounting treatment conforms to section 133 or other provisions.
attachments: Auditor certificate on the list of creditors
Auditor certificate and director declaration on deposits
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
